The '''Morrigan Scrolls''' were a collection of scrolls written by [[Darth Malak]] prior to his death<ref name="ffglords" /> in [[3956 BBY]].<ref name="hesdeadjim" /> The scrolls contained [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith]] knowledge and tactics from the [[Jedi Civil War]].<ref name="ffglords" />

==History==
By [[684 BBY]], they had fallen into the hands of [[Vortga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], and were stored in his treasure hoard on [[Pybus]]. Vortga died hundreds of years later on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], but the scrolls remained among his hidden treasures.<ref name="ffglords" />

To some collectors of antiquities, the scrolls had a monetary value of 5,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. However, those who recognized their true significance could pay 30,000 credits or more.<ref name="ffglords" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Morrigan Scrolls are mentioned only in the [[Fantasy Flight Games]] [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook ''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''. The scrolls were included as an example of the contents of Vortga the Hutt's treasure cache in the adventure module "The Dead Road," which can be set in any timeframe. The only fixed date given is the date of the construction of Vortga's complex, 684 BBY.
